# `network/realm/publishing/RealmJourneyJournal.js`

Signed publish/inspect/enter/leave history with exact branch-aware returns.

## Classes

### `class RealmJourneyJournal`

An append-only signed journal. Entry transitions are replayed locally; no network or storage side effects occur until a caller persists its snapshot.
